note.label: Esau the Hater, Liar, and Killer

precepts.why:
Woe, meaning destruction, is on him that builds his house by unrighteousness, and Habakkuk shows what that house is built on: “What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?”

So they practise idolatry. They have statues, and they bow down to them. The Bible says there is no profit in those things. A graven image is a teacher of lies, and the man who makes it trusts in the work of his own hands, a dumb idol that cannot speak.

That is the church of Esau, the hater, liar and killer. I can never understand how somebody in this modern day and age can be a Catholic: the same church that enslaved you, the same church that has statues all over the place. You can clearly read the Bible and say that this is not the way.

The house built by unrighteousness, by slavery and by robbing and pillaging countries, and the church of statues are the same house. The teacher of lies stands in the middle of it, and the woe of Jeremiah is on all of it.

precepts.text: Think about the mind frame of a person that follows idols. Somebody created this thing, formed it, then turned around and said this is the god that brought you out of Egypt. Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach. You are on a fast track to destruction following dumb idols.
precepts.point: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led. Why does he bring this up before what he is about to go over? Because they were not accustomed to godly order or sound doctrine. They were following dumb idols, doing what those idols' customs wanted instead of what the most high God wanted. To try to teach organization to a Hellenized Jew is extremely difficult; you got to let them know, that is not us anymore, you got to renew your mind.
precepts.why:
“Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.” Why does Paul bring this up before he goes over the order of the body? Because they were not accustomed to godly order or sound doctrine. They were following dumb idols, doing what those idols wanted instead of what the Most High God wanted. He tells the Ephesians the same: “remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh”. That was us too: Hellenized, living like heathens.

Think about the mind frame of a person that follows idols. Habakkuk: “What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?” Somebody created this thing, formed it, and then turned around and said this is God, this is what brought you out of Egypt. You know how dumb you have to be? You stupid.

“Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach!” Woe is destruction: destruction to him that says to the wooden idol, wake up, and to the dumb stone, arise. You are on a highway to hell, a fast track to destruction, following dumb idols.

That is why Paul reminds them of the mindset they came from: to teach organization to a Hellenized Jew is extremely difficult. You have to let them know, that is not us anymore. As Romans 12 says, you have to renew your mind. We do not conduct ourselves like that any longer; now we learn the order of the body of Christ.

precepts.text: Executing thy judgments upon them by little and little: a war here, a storm here, a plague there. Not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed: their hatred was baked in from the creation, and their way of thinking will never change. For it was a cursed seed from the beginning: Cain was cursed from the beginning, and Esau was cursed from the beginning. Neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned: no matter what they do, they can never be pardoned for the sins they have committed. Even the killings where the officer himself cannot say why he shot a man lying flat with his hands up: sometimes they do things they do not even know why they do.
precepts.point: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: something is wrong with that man; the Most High created him that way.
precepts.why:
Habakkuk says, “Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”. Something is wrong with that man; he is not normal. Wisdom of Solomon shows Esau: “But executing thy judgments upon them by little and little, thou gavest them place of repentance”. By little and little: a war here, a war there, a storm here, a tsunami there, a plague here, a plague there.

“Not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.” A naughty generation, like the border of wickedness. Their hatred was bred in them: when God created them, a couple of drops of hatred, put in the oven and baked, and you cannot get it out of the dough. Their cogitation, their way of thinking, their mind frame, will never change. The Lord created him that way.

Sometimes they do things they don't even know why they do. In Florida a man caring for handicapped kids lay flat on the ground with his hands up, and the cop shot him; asked why, the cop said, I don't know. In the South bodies are found hanging and the judgment is suicide, as if our brothers had superpowers to tie their own hands behind their backs and dunk their necks into the noose.

“For it was a cursed seed from the beginning”. Not a blessed seed: Cain was cursed from the beginning, and he came back as Esau, cursed from the beginning. “Neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned.” They cannot be pardoned. Their malice is bred in them, they are cursed from the beginning, their cogitation will never change, and no matter what they do they can never be pardoned for the sins they have committed. Your pastor done lied to you.

precepts.text: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine: the wine he transgresses by is the falsehood and the lying. Esau gave you Protestant, Mormon, Seventh-day Adventist, Jehovah's Witness, Pentecostal, Freemasonry, Rosicrucian: lies. Every institute of doctrine he put on this earth takes you away from God.
precepts.point: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: something is wrong with that man; the Most High created him that way.
precepts.why:
Habakkuk says of the proud man, “because he transgresseth by wine”. What is the wine he transgresses by? Micah gives the precept: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.”

The wine is the falsehood and the lying. Esau is a liar. He gave you Protestant: lies. Mormon: lies. Seventh-day Adventists, Jehovah's Witnesses, Pentecostal: lies. Freemasonry, Rosicrucian, Thelema: lies. Every institute of doctrine he put on this earth for you to follow and worship is a lie, and all they do is take you away from God.

That wine is how he rules. He “neither keepeth at home”: the US controls about 850 military bases in more than 90 countries, and there are more churches than military bases. The real way to control us is through Christianity, because we are more obedient to Christianity than to his military. And the church convinces you it is okay to be broke, okay to be poor and hurt, okay for your country to lie desolate while another man eats your riches: just pray to Jesus and you will be all right.

No, it is not okay. The earth belongs to us and it is going to come back to us. The just shall live by his faith, not by the wine of the prophet of lies.

precepts.text: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book: the book is the Bible.
precepts.point: News read in class: NASA and private companies like SpaceX are advancing plans for a permanent human presence on the moon through the Artemis program, and Artemis 2 just launched. You can have your doubting Thomas saying it is all fake; is it fake like the planes you fly on? A clip of Elon Musk was played discussing colonizing Mars. Why does Esau the Edomite want to go to Mars? Because it is the red planet.
precepts.why:
Habakkuk was in the Babylonian captivity, around 606 BC. The princes and the king were taken away, and Habakkuk was left because he was a poor prophet, so he stood on his tower complaining about what ancient Babylon did to us under Nebuchadnezzar. The Lord answered, “Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables”. Isaiah explains the tables for new people: “Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever”.

The table is the book, and the book is what we call the Bible today. The vision was not only for Habakkuk's day; it was noted in a book “for the time to come”, because “the vision is yet for an appointed time”.

Sometimes you read prophecy and want it to happen in your lifetime, but God says it is for a later date: though it tarry, wait for it. It was written down in the book so that when the end came it would speak and not lie. We are in that time period now, and the vision is plain on the tables for whoever will read it.

precepts.text: Behold, the days come, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord. They shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.
precepts.point: News read in class: NASA and private companies like SpaceX are advancing plans for a permanent human presence on the moon through the Artemis program, and Artemis 2 just launched. You can have your doubting Thomas saying it is all fake; is it fake like the planes you fly on? A clip of Elon Musk was played discussing colonizing Mars. Why does Esau the Edomite want to go to Mars? Because it is the red planet.
precepts.why:
The vision is written plain “that he may run that readeth it.” Amos explains the running: “Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord”.

There would be a famine of the word of the Lord. “And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.” People would travel from sea to sea, running to and fro, looking for the word and not finding it.

That is what happened after Christ and the disciples died: there was no truth being taught in the earth, nowhere. By the time of Constantine, around 325 AD, you had the churches, and there was no truth there; they were worshiping idols. Some of the Moors were Islamic, and some were black Jews following the Talmud and the Cabala. When white folks rose up it went crazy, into idolatry like you never saw: the church fathers making doctrine, and Tertullian, the devil that created the Trinity.

And they were traveling. The crusades went here and there trying to get the cup Christ drank from and to find the cross, trying to get some kind of glimpse of understanding. They ran to and fro, just as Amos said, because the word written plain in the book had nobody left to teach it.

precepts.text: My son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him: the apostles and disciples. After these years shall my son Christ die: he was crucified, and all the apostles and disciples that followed him died or were murdered by Rome. The world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, so that no man remain: no man that has truth. There were no Israelites saying we are the Israelites and we have to keep the commandments; you had the church fathers making doctrine instead.
precepts.point: News read in class: NASA and private companies like SpaceX are advancing plans for a permanent human presence on the moon through the Artemis program, and Artemis 2 just launched. You can have your doubting Thomas saying it is all fake; is it fake like the planes you fly on? A clip of Elon Musk was played discussing colonizing Mars. Why does Esau the Edomite want to go to Mars? Because it is the red planet.
precepts.why:
Amos says they would run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord and not find it. Ezra gives the precept that explains why: “For my son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.” Those with him were the apostles, the followers, the disciples. From Ezra's time to the time of Christ was four hundred years.

“After these years shall my son Christ die, and all men that have life.” Christ was crucified, and all the apostles and all the disciples that followed him either died or were murdered and crucified by Rome. All the men and women that had understanding were dead.

“And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.” So that no man that has truth shall remain. From the time after Christ and the disciples died, there was no truth being taught anywhere in the earth. There were no Israelites saying, we are the Israelites and we have to keep the commandments. Instead you had the church fathers, the damn devils, making doctrine, and Tertullian creating the Trinity.

That silence is the famine of hearing the words of the Lord. The world ran to and fro in it for centuries, and that is why the vision had to wait for its appointed time: at the end it shall speak, and not lie.

precepts.text: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs. Did not America do that? The white man came throughout this land and took all the dwelling places that were not his, and they are doing the same over there today.

You can have your doubting Thomas saying it is all fake; is it fake like the planes you fly on? A clip of Elon Musk was played discussing colonizing Mars. Why does Esau the Edomite want to go to Mars? Because it is the red planet.
precepts.why:
Habakkuk says, “Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”. Who is he talking about? Go back to chapter 1: “For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.”

Did not America do that? The white man came throughout this land and took all the dwelling places that were not his. And the so-called Israelis are doing the same thing over there today.

Though Habakkuk prophesied in the days of Babylon, the vision was for the appointed time at the end, and we are in that time now. So the proud man of chapter 2 is the man raised up in the last days. “He transgresseth by wine”: philosophies and lies. “He is a proud man”, like Edom in Obadiah. He “neither keepeth at home”: America is in everybody's country, with over 850 bases worldwide. He “enlargeth his desire as hell”: when he takes your land he brings democracy and Christianity, and your whole society turns to hell. He destabilizes and bombs your country, then lets a remnant come to the United States, which is why America is called the great melting pot.

“Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” Did you forget Venezuela already? He took Venezuela and the oil. He steals and robs, possessing dwelling places that are not his, just as the Chaldeans did.

precepts.text: I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: space travel. I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north: that is us, in North America. I will ascend above the heights of the clouds: airplanes. How could that part be true, because you see it, but the verse above it about the stars be fake?

You can have your doubting Thomas saying it is all fake; is it fake like the planes you fly on? A clip of Elon Musk was played discussing colonizing Mars. Why does Esau the Edomite want to go to Mars? Because it is the red planet.
precepts.why:
Habakkuk says, “Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!” Is that not what Nimrod and them were doing? Before we get scattered, let us build a tower and get up to heaven. Today's Babylon has the same characteristics and attributes. Jeremiah said it too: “Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her”.

Isaiah shows the heart of it: “For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”. That is space travel. NASA and SpaceX are advancing plans for a permanent presence on the moon through the Artemis program, and Artemis 2 just went up. Elon Musk talks of colonizing Mars. Why does Esau the Edomite want to go to Mars? Because it is the red planet.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: that is us, in North America. “I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: that is airplanes. How could that part be true, because you see it, while the verse above it about the stars is fake? You can have your doubting Thomas saying it's all fake. Is it fake like the planes you fly on and the helicopters you see? Stop watching stupid YouTube clips.

He sets his nest on high thinking he will be delivered from the power of evil when destruction comes. But he “hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people”. “Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!” America was built with blood: the schools, the churches and the courthouses are on the bones and blood of our brothers and sisters. Did not Cain establish a city by iniquity? There is no new thing under the sun.

precepts.text: The vision is for an appointed time and will not tarry; his soul is not upright in him, he is a proud man who keepeth not at home, with bases in every country, who enlargeth his desire as hell and is as death: hell and death of Revelation 6 is America.
precepts.point: Power was given over the fourth part of the earth, which is America's Western Hemisphere, to kill with sword, with hunger, with death and with the beasts of the earth: the wars and rumours of wars, the beginning of sorrows of Matthew 24. When the Lord says he will bring plagues, this is how he brings them.
precepts.why:
“And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.” The pale horse is America, the oppressor. He brings death and destruction wherever he goes. No matter what president gets into office, they fulfill that role. Obama did it secretly: he went and killed Gaddafi, who was trying to uplift the people of Libya, and nobody said a word because Obama was a black man. Trump does it openly. Their own people admit that US sanctions and wars have killed some 38 million people since 1971.

Habakkuk explains that hell and death are America. “For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.” The vision is the prophecy, and we are seeing it take place right now.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”. God says the white man’s soul is not right, and some of you want to save him. “He is a proud man”: see how Trump talks proud and arrogant. “Neither keepeth at home”: America is never in its own country; it has military bases all over the earth, in everybody’s country, dictating and oppressing. “Who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death”: wherever he goes the people catch hell, and he brings death.

That is Revelation 6: Death on the pale horse and Hell following him. America is the number one weapons supplier, and all the wars in the last days America will be responsible for in some form or fashion, directly or indirectly. As God used Nebuchadnezzar to fulfil his prophecy, he is using America: with sword, with hunger, with death, the beginning of sorrows.

precepts.text: The vision is for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie; though it tarry, wait for it. What is read in Revelation is guaranteed. Wait for it is the counsel to the elect.
precepts.point: But rather that ye may prophesy. That is why the class deals with prophecy first. A captain adds that the purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit and prepare you for temptation and destruction; when you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
“Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.” That is why we deal with prophecy first. What we are watching in the news lines up with the scriptures: the fourth kingdom of Daniel 2, partly strong as iron and partly broken, mingling itself with the seed of men; and the ten horns of Revelation 17, NATO, that gave their power and strength unto the beast, America, since 1945, now turning on her, twenty-eight nations signing in the middle of the night to stand without the United States.

All the prophets saw the same thing. Habakkuk: “For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie”. What we read in Revelation is for an appointed time, and it shall not lie; it is guaranteed. What we read in Isaiah, in Habakkuk, in Revelation will happen.

“though it tarry, wait for it”. We hear the Bishop bring out the revelations and the breakdowns, and it is taking its time, while the Christians do not have it at all; it is oblivious to their minds, distracted with prosperity doctrine. Wait for it: that is the counsel given to the elect. Be patient and get yourself right, because the vision will come to pass, and the nations will turn on each other.

“because it will surely come, it will not tarry”. Just as the Most High hardened Pharaoh's heart, he has a proud man in power who will say and do anything and take everybody's stuff; that is how it is going to happen. God put it in their hearts to fulfill his will, so we do not have to worry: we know what is going to happen before it happens.

precepts.text: His soul which is lifted up is not upright in him, that is Esau; but the just shall live by his faith, which Paul quotes, and the just are those keeping the law, holy, just and good.
precepts.point: The just shall live by faith, from Habakkuk; the law is not of faith but the promise predates the law and sacrifice; and Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us, so that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles, the northern kingdom.

note.label: Navigating Through Paul's Letters: Works Of The Law & Liberty

precepts.why:
Galatians 3:11 says, “But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.” The law that cannot justify is the law of sacrifice. Paul is quoting Habakkuk 2:4.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”. That is Esau. His soul is not right by spirit, by nature, by biology; that nation is not right at all in the spirit or in their heads. “but the just shall live by his faith.” That is where Paul got it.

Abraham's faith was counted for righteousness, and his faith came first, before his works; then his works proved his faith, because they go hand in hand. So the just shall live by faith, and that faith is faith in Christ. The just are those keeping God's laws, the law that is holy, just and good, and they live by faith in Christ, not by the blood of animals.

precepts.text: Write the vision and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it. The Bible is going to turn this whole system upside down.
precepts.point: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man; God will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able, but will with the temptation make a way to escape. If you understand the joy of the elect you embrace the temptation, because he has your back. He wants you to make it, though there are those appointed to die. Nobody wanted to pay a landlord who tripled the rent in Brooklyn after counting heads across the street; that trial forced us to pool the real estate, carpentry, plumbing, and electrical talent the Lord had among us, and then he blessed us with the building in New York despite the detractors. We never took our eyes off the prize. Do not let anyone take your crown.

note.label: The Divine Orchestration and Purpose of the People You Encounter

precepts.why:
The table the Lord prepares before us in the presence of our enemies is the Bible. Habakkuk shows it: “And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.”

The Lord told the prophet Habakkuk: since you want to get out of captivity, write the vision down, and make it plain upon the tables. That is what we are supposed to be reading.

Make it plain “that he may run that readeth it”: when we bring this out, everybody is going to be running, and we are going to run to teach it. The Bible is going to turn this whole system upside down: these are they which have turned the world upside down. But we have to be in it like that, not reading about overseas like entertainment while our own spirit is rotten.

precepts.point: Thou hast not judged the earth with truth; thou hast afflicted the meek, hurt the peaceable, loved liars, the dirty lawyers who manipulate the law to do America's bidding, destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm.

note.label: America At War With Iran: Preparation For Conflict

precepts.why:
The eagle is told, “thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable, thou hast loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm.” The fourth beast was Rome, and America is its extension, ruling with much wicked oppression. America just bombed a school and killed 165 schoolgirls. Wicked as hell. Habakkuk shows what comes back on such a nation.

“Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee”. America has spoiled many nations, and now we see it is America and Israel, Trump and Netanyahu, doing it together. What is the reason? “because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.”

So the remnant of the people, the nations America has spoiled, shall spoil it. That is what we are watching as Iran answers with missiles the Iron Dome cannot stop, a single missile that turns into eighty. The eagle that cast down the walls of such as did it no harm will have its own walls cast down, because of men's blood.

precepts.text: He transgresseth by wine, his philosophies and policies (Micah 2:11, prophesying of wine and strong drink is the spirit of falsehood); he is a proud man, none prouder than Trump; keepeth not at home but is in Venezuela and Iran; enlargeth his desire as hell, and wherever he sets up democracy the place goes to hell; is as death and cannot be satisfied, now wanting Greenland and Canada; and gathereth unto him all nations, the melting pot.
